name: @hxmc/ui
description: A UI toolkit for hxmc, in pure Haxe: a retained node tree with flexbox layout, events and focus (hxmc.ui), drawn with the GPU on hxmc.gfx (hxmc.ui.draw) or as the platform's controls (hxmc.ui.native), written in @hxmc/view's markup and signals (its renderer: hxmc.ui.view)
